description: This file contains implementation code for tensor sorting operations specifically optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch's ATen library. It includes functions for computing kth smallest values and sorting tensors using MPSGraph, with handling for various tensor shapes and types.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A helper class that caches MPSGraph objects and related tensors for optimized repeated execution within the MPS backend.

methods.name: kthvalue_out_mps_impl
methods.description: Implements the core logic for computing the kth smallest values along a specified dimension using MPSGraph, handling various tensor shapes and error conditions.

methods.name: sort_stable_out_mps
methods.description: Performs a stable sort of a tensor using MPSGraph, supporting descending order and outputting sorted values and indices.
